'''Grey Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BtRF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Grey Squadron got involved in a battle in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] with a large [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] force that included [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] starfighters as well as [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunships]]. The Imperial squadron suffered heavy casualties but, thanks to the intervention of [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]], it was able eliminate all Rebel vessels.<ref name="SWG:BtRF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grey Squadron appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BtRF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Grey Squadron was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:BtRF" />
